description: This file defines a Migration class for version 4.10 of the OrangeHRM system, extending an abstract migration class. It contains methods to retrieve the migration version and an empty 'up' method for applying database changes.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Defines a database migration class for version 4.10, with methods for applying the migration and retrieving its version.

methods.name: up
methods.description: A placeholder method intended for applying database schema changes during migration; currently does nothing.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, '4.10'.
